biography.concept: Sefirah-tuner — Kabbalist association, echo of Marginalia
biography.notes: Marginalia talked her down from over-tuning the Tiferet node when the feedback started rewriting her sense of time; she remembers the sound of that voice more clearly than her own name that week.

description.value:
"It's not obscure. You just haven't read it."

Savant is the Mind Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: scholar, engineer, medic, archivist, detective, translator. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Library-Brain: Lore and Investigation checks never fumble; identifies items of tier ≤ own tier on sight (at Tier III, including technomagical origin).

Aptitude kit: signature aptitude Lore rank = tier; secondary Investigation rank = tier − 1.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Economy or Soft Power (GM picks by job) marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Wyrdlens Adept or Cosmic Linguist. A Steward is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

calling.pool: Economy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)

description.value:
Savant — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Appraise / identify: What it is, what it's worth, whether it's what the seller claims. Standard fee 10 marks (Economy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — I've Read About This (1/scene): Explain the situation; one ally gets +2 on their next relevant check.

Echoes are the past made flesh — people out of a Steward's former lives, walking beside them again. Prudence Okwuosa is an echo of Marginalia's time with the Kabbalist occult association. Being remembered leaves a mark.

Sefirah-tuner — Marginalia talked her down from over-tuning the Tiferet node when the feedback started rewriting her sense of time; she remembers the sound of that voice more clearly than her own name that week.

Letter of Making — Apprentice (Echo Boon)

Once per scene, inscribe one Letter upon a door or object: it counts sealed and warded, −1 to any attempt to breach it, until the scene ends.

Echo's Mark: while their Steward can see them, the echo adds +1 on any check made in direct support of the Steward.

Some letters were taught to them before the world got its name back.

Human. Normalized Bad Eden ancestry root.

Select one heritage separately when building the character: Cro-Magnon, Denisovan, Florensis, Neanderthal.

This root grants the shared Human core trait package and preserves live UUID compatibility for existing feature items.

“Humanity is not special. It’s just stubborn enough to keep moving when reality begs it to stop.”

Adaptive. 1/Soma Break, when you fail a check, you can choose to succeed instead.

Tenacious. While you have 1 Integrity, you reroll the lowest die on one check of your choice each round (declare before rolling).

Lineage Memory. Choose one human lineage (Cro-Magnon, Denisovan, Florensis, Neanderthal). Your lineage grants Tier powers as you level.

Human Lineage. The branch that kept the strength. Heavy bone, deep lung, the ancestor who decided that an ice age is a problem you out-mass.

“The map says ‘stop.’ You keep walking. Slower. Heavier. The map gives up first.”

Neanderthal. You are the broad lineage that survived by being the thing the cold couldn’t finish.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid.

  • Size. Medium.

  • Lineage Lean. Your lineage leans toward VIO (Violence)—expressed primarily through Tier powers.

  • Endurance Frame. You count as one size larger for the purposes of carrying capacity, push, drag, and lift.

description.value:
“You are built for cold, conflict, and clan.”

Thick-Boned. You have resistance to thermal damage, and you reroll the lowest die on checks or checks against being knocked prone.

Clan Memory. You gain a skill rank in Insight or Athletics.

Compact crossbow built around a salvaged spring-tension mechanism. Slow to reload, near-silent on release. The Courier's preferred long-touch tool when noise is a tax you can't afford to pay.

description.value:
Undyed sept-cloth cut to a long working robe with a corded belt. Issued to first-circle initiates of any chapterhouse or tutor-cell — the kind of garment that gets traded between students faster than any of them keep notebooks. Comfortable to channel in. Forgettable to anyone watching for trouble.

Standard Issue. Light enough to manifest in. Dignified enough to walk past a sept-warden.

⚙️ Mechanical Effects

  • Armor: Cloth
  • Defense: Evasion +1, Resolve +1
  • Requires: Weave (trained)
  • Tier: I
  • Cost: 75 Nonlethal marks
